title: Enforce declared gates in closeout evaluation
description: WHY: this is the mechanical check the consumer audit asked for - close should be rejected unless evidence matches the gate declared at filing. WHAT: extend evidenceGateSatisfaction and verificationGateSatisfaction (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 1401-1483) so that when a gate carries declaredCommand, only evidence whose command field (post-redaction - note redactSensitiveCommand rewrites secrets at packages/evidence-engine/src/evidence.ts lines 133-145, so match against the redacted form) equals declaredCommand counts, and when expectedObservable is present the evidence summary must match it. Unsatisfied declared gates produce the sprint 2 gap codes (for example gate.declared.command-mismatch, gate.declared.observable-missing) so the failure is directive-ready. Forced gates keep their existing typed escape hatch (records.ts lines 92-100). Cover both close paths: closeWork (runtime.ts lines 652-709) and finishReservedWork (lines 711-849).
acceptanceCriteria: A fixture item with a declared gate cannot close when evidence command differs or the observable is absent, and the thrown gaps carry the new codes
The same item closes cleanly when matching evidence is attached, in both close paths
Redacted-command matching is covered by a test using a command containing a secret flag
closedReason: Implemented and verified in checkpoint e09ddf37.
